Prevention: Remove the plant debris from the field.
Monitoring: Installation of pheromone traps @5 nos./ha coinciding with the initiation of flowering and destruction of collected moths.
Field infestation 3 to 4 larvae per meter row length
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Application of neem seed kernel extract 5% as a repellent for egg laying.
Metarhizium anisopliae @ 30 gram/10 liter have been effectively used to control lepidopteran larvae and other pests.
Release of the egg parasitoid, Trichogramma chilonis or
Lakh/ha coinciding with flower initiation at 15 days interval.
